interfaces.name: package_outline
interfaces.what: VQFN-32, TI package drawing RHB0032E: body 4.9000..5.1000 mm square, height 1.0000 mm MAX, standoff 0.0000..0.0500 mm, 32 leads on a 0.5000 mm pitch (28 x 0.5000 across the drawing's dimension chain), lead 0.2000..0.3000 mm wide x 0.3000..0.5000 mm long, exposed thermal pad 3.4500 +/- 0.1000 mm square (terminal 33), lead rows 2 x 3.5000 mm apart, pin-1 index area in one corner. The drawing NOTES require the thermal pad to be soldered to the board for thermal and mechanical performance. The frame is the package centre ON THE SEATING PLANE (z = 0 is the PCB land plane). `accepts` is EMPTY on purpose: an SMT land joint is connection:solder-smt, which is NOT on this shelf — naming it would dangle, and a dangling ref is a FAIL in bin/triad check, never a warning.
interfaces.source: READ OFF THE VENDOR'S OWN MECHANICAL DRAWING: Texas Instruments PACKAGE OUTLINE RHB0032E, 'VQFN - 1 mm max height', drawing number 4223442/B dated 08/2019, PAGE 100 of 103 of the TLV320AIC3104 datasheet — the copy in this folder (current/datasheet.pdf, sha256 in current/PROVENANCE.json), read 2026-09-02 (lane T)
